title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Tourist Guides Acts 2013

sections.shortTitle: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Tourist Guides Acts 2013
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

AN
The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Tourist Guides Acts,
2013
AN
ACT
to
amend the Pakistan Tourist Guides
Act, 1976.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Pakistan Tourist Guides Act,
1976 (Act No. XXVI of 1976), for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short title, extent and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Tourist Guides (Amendment) Act, 2013.
(2) It extends to the whole of the Province of the
Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
(3) It shall come into force at once.
